# CF Portal - The Children's Forum

> A comprehensive early childhood education portal for Florida childcare professionals managing scholarships, credentials, memberships, and wage incentive programs.

CF Portal serves as the central login and management hub for The Children's Forum's suite of early childhood education programs, including TEACH scholarships, SEEC credentials, INCENTIVE$ Florida wages, and professional membership. The platform connects childcare workers, employers, and program owners across Florida with resources for professional development and licensing.

## Key Topics

- TEACH Early Childhood® Scholarship
- CF Portal Account Management
- Early Childhood Education (ECE)
- SEEC Childcare Credential Program
- INCENTIVE$ Florida Wage Incentive
- Children's Forum Membership
- CDA Credential Renewal
- DCF-Licensed Childcare Programs
- Scholarship Application Process
- TEACH Directory of Degrees and Credentials
- Professional Development
- Florida Childcare Licensing
- Employee & Employer Sponsorship
- Balance Payments & Online Processing
- Business Account Access

## Core Portal & Account Management

- [Dashboard | CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com): CF Portal dashboard for account management, TEACH scholarships, and ECE programs
- [Login - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/membership/join): CF Portal login for personal and business account authentication
- [CF Membership - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/membership/landing): Children's Forum membership with CDA and Florida credential renewal
- [Program access request - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/siteaccessrequest): Request DCF-licensed child care program access to CF Portal

## TEACH Early Childhood Scholarship

- [Overview for employees - TEACH - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/teach/landing): TEACH Early Childhood Scholarship program overview for Florida employees
- [Overview for employees - TEACH - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/teach/landing/applicant): TEACH Early Childhood Scholarship overview and application guide for employees
- [Overview for employers - TEACH - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/teach/landing/sponsor): TEACH Early Childhood Scholarship guide for employer sponsors
- [Overview for owners - TEACH - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/teach/landing/owners): TEACH Early Childhood Scholarship overview for family child care home owners
- [Search - TEACH Directory of Degrees and Credentials - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/degreedatabase): Searchable directory of degrees and credentials for TEACH scholarships
- [FAQs - TEACH - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/teach/faq): Frequently asked questions about TEACH Scholarship applications and requirements
- [Pay a Balance - TEACH - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/teach/payments): Online payment processing for TEACH program balance payments

## Professional Development Programs

- [Introduction - SEEC - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/seec/landing): SEEC childcare credential program overview and eligibility requirements
- [Introduction - INCENTIVE$ Florida - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/wages/landing): INCENTIVE$ Florida wage incentive program for child care workers

- [Policies - Home - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/index/rules): CF Portal policies covering membership, verification, and ECE standards
- [Privacy & Confidentiality - Policies - CF Portal](https://login.thechildrensforum.com/index/rules-privacy): Privacy policy and confidentiality guidelines for CF Portal users
